items.title: Prevention of relapse/recurrence in major depression by mindfulness-based cognitive therapy
items.rights_note: Publicly readable author/education-hosted copy; cache privately because redistribution rights are unclear.

items.title: Effects of mindfulness-based cognitive therapy on mental disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
items.rights_note: Open review covering programme identity and outcomes; explicitly notes that included studies did not assess adverse effects.

items.title: Relapse Prevention in Major Depressive Disorder: Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy Versus an Active Control Condition
items.rights_note: Open active-control trial; structurally matched comparison should remain distinct from treatment-as-usual evidence.

items.title: The empirical status of mindfulness-based interventions: A systematic review of 44 meta-analyses of randomized controlled trials
items.rights_note: Open cross-program meta-review; MBCT-specific findings must not be blended with MBSR or other mindfulness programmes.

items.title: Doing no harm in mindfulness-based programs: Conceptual issues and empirical findings
items.rights_note: Open harm framework covering MBCT and MBSR; distinguishes adverse events, sustained attributable harm and under-reporting.

items.title: Improved Mindfulness Following Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy: Results from a Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial with Trauma-Exposed Black Adults
items.rights_note: Open pilot of trauma-informed, culturally responsive adaptation; feasibility-scale evidence must not be generalized to standard MBCT.

items.title: Depression in adults: treatment and management — Recommendations
items.rights_note: Current NICE guidance; use only for the populations and decision points explicitly stated.
